violation_type.title: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies (26 TAC §746.401(10))
violation_type.typical_finding: A child's food allergies were not posted in the kitchen and the child's room. This was corrected during the inspection when the child's allergies were posted in the kitchen and in each room the child uses.

finding_variants.text: A child's food allergies were not posted in the kitchen and the child's room. This was corrected during the inspection when the child's allergies were posted in the kitchen and in each room the child uses.

The Food Allergy Emergency Plan for a child with a diagnosed food allergy was not posted at the operation.    Corrected at Inspection: The food allergy plan was posted in every classroom in which the child is present.
Food Allergy's were not posted in the classroom during the inspection.
There was no postings of the children whose parents identified had food allergies. This was corrected at the inspection when a form was created and posted.
The operation did not post a list of a child s food allergy that requires an emergency plan.
The operation did not have the required posting up for a child with a medically diagnosed food allergy.
